_readme: Hand-authored English for every Chinese string that can reach a screen and that
no other tier resolves. One entry per exact string as it appears.
Two kinds of entry. Most are coverage: a string with no English anywhere, which
leaves Chinese on a reviewer's screen. The rest carry override:true and REPLACE
an English form another tier already produced, because that form is wrong in a
way the gate can see: a name that loses a qualifier, or a phrase answered with
Several entries are single characters or spliced fragments. They are not words
and their English is not a translation anybody would write on purpose. They are
here because the string reaches a screen and a reviewer must not be shown
Chinese; each note says what the fragment was split out of.

10％NaOH溶液.note: OVERRIDES gold_alias, which returns 'sodium hydroxide' and drops 10％. The strength is what was charged in the comparative example's step 2 and is the only concentration that step states, so losing it loses the charge.

遇水迅速分解成甲醇和氢氧化钠.en: decomposes rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide
遇水迅速分解成甲醇和氢氧化钠.note: OVERRIDES source_mt, which returned the whole of [0009] at 62.8x this phrase's length. The patent's stated reason for avoiding sodium methoxide.

1g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.008mol).note: OVERRIDES source_mt, which returned the whole Example 2 step 2 charge list at 40.4x. This is the charge whose printed mass and mole count disagree, so it is quoted on its own as the evidence for that finding and must read as the phrase it is.

0.226g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.001mol).note: OVERRIDES source_mt, which returned the whole Example 3 step 2 charge list at 33.1x. Same finding as the Example 2 charge.

2.26g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.01mol).note: OVERRIDES source_mt, which returned the whole Example 4 step 2 charge list at 35.2x. Same finding again.

异戊二烯基醌.note: [0002], the biosynthesis an HPPD inhibitor blocks. Named as a class, so plural and unresolved to any one compound.

反应溶剂.note: Claim 4 and [0021], the generic the claim enumerates rather than names.

结晶溶剂.note: Claims 4 and 10, distinguished from 反应溶剂 in the same sentence, so the two are kept apart.

整出.note: [0089] prints 整出, which is not a verb used with 溶剂. 蒸出, distilled off, is evidently meant. Translated to what the step does and the misprint recorded here rather than corrected in the gold.

蒸出.note: The correctly printed form, [0086]. Kept as its own entry so the misprint at [0089] can be seen beside it.

只有.note: Background, introducing each prior-art yield the patent objects to.

制备.note: Used in 在制备X的时候 throughout the background and the beneficial effects.

的时候.note: The second half of 在制备X的时候.

合成.note: The step headings and the title.

用量较大.en: used in a comparatively large amount
用量较大.note: [0008], the objection to the condensing agent of CN106008290A.

以下.note: Claim 1 and [0014] to [0018]: 在80℃以下, at or below 80 C. A bound, not a value.

解.note: The bare character, split out of 碱解. In 碱解 it is alkaline hydrolysis of the methyl ester; alone it carries only the general sense.

步骤.note: Every dependent claim opens 步骤N)中.

在.note: The bare preposition, split out of 在X℃ constructions.

剩余物.note: [0016] and the examples: what remains after the etherification filtrate is concentrated, before the base is added.

往剩余物里加.note: The one-pot join in step 2, where the alkaline hydrolysis begins without isolating the ester.

米黄色固体.note: The abstract's description of the product. The examples print 米黄色结晶粉末, beige crystalline powder, which is a different and more specific form.

反应完全后加入进行洗.en: after the reaction was complete, added and washed
反应完全后加入进行洗.note: A spliced fragment: the source reads 反应完全后加入水进行水洗, with 水 in two places. Translated as the fragment stands rather than repaired.

滴.note: The counter in 4滴丙酮氰醇 in the comparative example, which is why that charge has no mass and no mole count.

的合成.note: The step heading form, N、X的合成.

滴加.note: The addition verb this document uses throughout, and the reason several steps state a temperature only on an addition.

升温回流反应.note: Step 3's acid chloride formation. A heating method, not a temperature.

优选的.note: Opens the preferred molar ratios at [0019], [0022] and [0025].

化.note: The bare suffix, split out of 醚化 and 酸化. Not a word on its own.

氰.note: The bare character, split out of 丙酮氰醇, acetone cyanohydrin.

气.note: The bare character, split out of 湿气, moisture, in the sodium methoxide hazard sentence.

line 152 step 3 conditions: {\"text\": \.note: The provenance row for arrow 3 of the drawn scheme at [0029], where the methyl ester is hydrolysed with base and the product is then liberated by acidification. Two reagents in sequence, not a choice between them, which the solidus alone does not say. Only the Chinese inside the quote is translated; the rest of the row is the pipeline's own English and is left as it is.
